scope: Curated provider identity associations for Gate research only; not investment approvals

avalanche-2.purpose: Avalanche network utility: AVAX pays Primary Network fees and secures staking.
avalanche-2.token_value_capture: Primary Network fees are burned; staking rewards mint AVAX. Burning alone does not guarantee falling supply or price appreciation.

binancecoin.purpose: BNB pays BNB Smart Chain execution fees and is used for network staking.
binancecoin.token_value_capture: Validators receive transaction-fee rewards. Network activity is not a guaranteed dividend or return for every BNB holder.

near.purpose: NEAR pays transaction fees, covers on-chain storage and supports validator staking.
near.token_value_capture: Storage balances are locked while data remains; delegated staking can earn rewards. Holding alone does not guarantee project profit sharing.
